# §6 Portal Engagement — Highlight Candidates

1. **Stable portal traffic at ~44 daily visitors** — The portal averaged roughly 44 unique visitors per day across the trailing 7 months (Oct 2025 – Apr 2026) with 52,403 total pageviews and sessions averaging over 5 minutes. [→ §portal]
2. **Florida and North Carolina drive portal engagement** — Florida (1,962 visitors) and North Carolina (1,497) together account for over 3,400 visitors in the trailing 7 months, anchoring geographic demand in traditional furniture markets. [→ §portal]
3. **November pageview spike at 12,062** — November 2025 recorded the highest monthly pageview count despite a typical visitor average of 43.7/day, suggesting deeper catalog browsing activity — potentially tied to seasonal product reviews. [→ §portal]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **LOW**: Search and advertising drive 7% of portal traffic in the trailing 7 months — expanding search-optimized catalog pages or targeted advertising could incrementally broaden buyer reach beyond the existing direct-link base [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §portal]
